# NotOptimalRegularExpressions

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `NotOptimalRegularExpressionsInspection`

A family of checks on PCRE patterns passed to the `preg_*` functions: broken
or missing delimiters, invalid / pointless / missing modifiers, class
spellings that have a shorter escape, redundant or backtracking-prone
constructs, and calls where a plain string function (`strpos`,
`str_replace`, `trim`, `explode`, a `===` comparison) does the same job
faster. Only a few findings carry a fix (the plain-function replacements).

## Example

Default level (e.g. 7.0):

```php{6,7,8,11,12,13,14,17,18,19,23,24,25,30,31,32,33,35}
<?php
function modifiersDemo($line, $m) {
    preg_match('%k\d+%', $line, $m);
    preg_match('[k\d+]x', $line, $m);
    preg_match('', $line, $m);
    preg_match('k\d+', $line, $m);
    preg_match(')k\d(', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/k\d/9', $line, $m);
    preg_quote('k.d', '/');
    preg_quote('/k/Q', '/');
    preg_replace('#k(\d)#e', '$1', $line);
    preg_replace(['#k(\d)#e'], '$1', $line);
    preg_match('/k\d/Q', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/(k)\d/n', $line, $m);

    preg_match('/^k\d$/D', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/^k\d/D', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/k\$/D', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/k\d$/mD', $line, $m);

    preg_match('/k.\d/s', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/k\[.\]/s', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/k\d+/s', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/k[.,]\d/s', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/k\.\d/s', $line, $m);

    preg_match('/k\d/i', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/\\d/i', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/ид/iu', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/\d{3}-\d{2}/i', $line, $m);
    preg_match('/
        \s+ \W
    /ix', $line, $m);

    $rx = 'k\w+';
    preg_match($rx, $line, $m);
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: Pattern has no valid delimiters.</li>
<li>line 7: Pattern has no valid delimiters.</li>
<li>line 8: Pattern has no valid delimiters.</li>
<li>line 11: The /e flag was removed from PCRE; use a callback replacement.</li>
<li>line 12: The /e flag was removed from PCRE; use a callback replacement.</li>
<li>line 13: &#39;Q&#39; is not a valid PCRE modifier.</li>
<li>line 14: &#39;n&#39; is not a valid PCRE modifier.</li>
<li>line 17: The /D flag is pointless: the pattern has no &#39;$&#39;.</li>
<li>line 18: The /D flag is pointless: the pattern has no &#39;$&#39;.</li>
<li>line 19: The /D flag has no effect together with /m.</li>
<li>line 23: The /s flag is pointless: the pattern has no &#39;.&#39;.</li>
<li>line 24: The /s flag is pointless: the pattern has no &#39;.&#39;.</li>
<li>line 25: The /s flag is pointless: the pattern has no &#39;.&#39;.</li>
<li>line 30: The /i flag is pointless: the pattern has no letters.</li>
<li>line 31: The /i flag is pointless: the pattern has no letters.</li>
<li>line 35: Pattern has no valid delimiters.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "NotOptimalRegularExpressions": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore NotOptimalRegularExpressions

/**
 * @noinspection NotOptimalRegularExpressionsInspection
 */
```
